مُؤَنَّثٌ [A feminine word; a word made feminine. ―
-b2- Also,] (T, A, K,) and ↓ أَنِيثٌ , (AA, T,) and ↓ مِئْنَاثٌ , (K,) and ↓ مِئْنَاثَةٌ , (TA,) (tropical:) i. q. مُخَنَّثٌ, (AA, T, A, K,) i. e. An effeminate man; one who resembles a woman (AA, T, TA) in gentleness, and in softness of speech, and in an affectation of languor of the limbs: (TA:) or a man in the form, or make, of a female. (T.) ―
-b3- سَيْفٌ مُؤَنَّثٌ: see أَنِيثٌ. ―
-b4- طِيبٌ مُؤَنَّثٌ (tropical:) Perfume that is used by women; such as خَلُوق and زَعْفَران, (Sh, T, L,) and what colours the clothes: (L:) ذُكُورَةُ الطِّيبِ being such perfumes as have no colour; such as غَالِيَة and كَافُور and مِسْك and عُود and عَنْبَر and the like, which leave no mark. (T, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
